context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on hiring philosophy
purpose: Teach: 学歴/管轄/債券/互換/受験生/行え/工法/断定

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 学歴だけで人を見るな。互換性ある経験を見抜け。
lines.en: Don't judge people by their credentials alone. Learn to spot the experience that actually transfers.
lines.style: Measured, the opening unhurried. Low register. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. The voice of someone who has seen this mistake made a hundred times and is speaking from that patience.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しております。管轄を越えて、断定的に指示できる人材は宝です。
lines.en: I understand. People who can make clear decisions across different departments—those are invaluable.
lines.style: Respectful but present. Not servile. Firm acknowledgment of the point, meeting it as an equal would. Slight emphasis on the gravity of what he's hearing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 受験生時代の根性で泥臭く動ける人、見極めろ。
lines.en: Identify those who can work through obstacles with the same determination they had as exam students.
lines.style: Direct, no softening. Short rhythmic beats. The voice tightens slightly—this is the crucial part. Not harsh, but unmistakably instruction that expects attention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。債券、最新の工法も学ばせています。
lines.en: Yes. We're having them study bonds, new construction methods—the practical knowledge they'll need.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Warm but professional. Shows he's already thinking in this direction. Slight rise of energy—he's engaged, not merely compliant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若手が行える領域を着実に広げろ。
lines.en: Steadily expand what your younger staff are capable of handling.
lines.style: Quiet but commanding. No rush. The weight of a principle being handed down. Final word lingers slightly—this is the legacy piece, and he's giving Hiroshi the responsibility of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Intimate in register but not sentimental. Genuine commitment. Brief, respectful. The kind of quiet that follows a conversation that has changed something, however small.
